entries.fcda6e51128732c0: Since its founding in 1929, the company has continued to operate as a specialist manufacturer of railway signal safety devices, and has a structure in which the group handles not only manufacturing and sales of equipment but also installation work and maintenance and repair. In the current fiscal year, it advanced product development to meet the needs of railway operators, including developing a wireless train control system for regional-area lines that reduces on-site equipment, and obtaining SIL4 certification under the international standard IEC62279 (software) for electronic interlocking devices.
